description: This file is a shell library for testing credential handling in Git. It includes functions for testing credential helpers, such as storing, retrieving, and rejecting credentials, handling long headers, timeouts, password expiry, OAuth tokens, authtypes, and ephemeral credentials. The script also defines an askpass script used for automated prompting.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Sets credential options and runs a series of read and eval commands to test credential helper responses, verifying the output against expected values.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads lines from stdin until a line with '--' is encountered, outputting each line.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Cleans residual credential data for common test cases.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects specific credentials via the git credential reject command.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Conducts a comprehensive suite of tests on a given credential helper, including storing, retrieving, overwriting, forgetting, and handling edge cases.

methods.name: helper_test_timeout
methods.description: Tests the behavior of a credential helper under a timeout scenario.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests storing, retrieving, and overwriting password expiry timestamps.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests handling of authtype and credential capabilities, including storage with usernames, exclusion criteria, ephemeral credentials, and associated data.
